source.check: names as printed in the Ulster Herald (29 April 1933, p. 4): 'the following were returned unopposed'; checked against the Belfast News-Letter's list (21 April 1933, p. 11), 'There is no contest, and not a change in the personnel of the council'

note: Triennial election of the Castlederg rural district councillors, 1933. Thirteen divisions had one nomination each and were returned unopposed; 'There will be no election in the Castlederg district' (Ulster Herald, 29 April 1933, p. 4). No nominations were received for Ardarver, Ballymongan and Clunahill and 'the retiring members will be deemed to be re-elected'; as no 1933 source names them, those three divisions are held, not recorded. No party labels are printed. No poll was held; Tyrone's polling day was Wednesday 31 May 1933. Returned unopposed.
